<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

OBSERVED 2026-09-02 (prime, live): after the rs daemon was restarted for the #342 deploy, every already-open omp stopped receiving bodies. Trace: spine 1682 message.pushed published → the omp never injected (its /v1/events stream died with the old process; pumpEventStream reports the error and exits; the only watchEvents call is the boot-time attach) → the queue row fell to the pointer worker (spine 1688) → operator pane shows `message waiting — run: pij inbox`. Second symptom, same root: the omp pij_send TOOL fails `missing or wrong bearer token` because the daemon key is per boot and the extension read it once at boot. A fresh omp works (spine 1696-1698: pushed → injected → inbox-ack, no pointer). The extension has no reconnect, no cursor, no key refresh. This plan gives it all three. Ruling context: pointer is RETIRED for omp/pi (rulings/2026-09-01-tmux-types-full-bodies.md); a pointer after a restart is a defect.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- G1 Reconnect: when the /v1/events stream ends or errors, the extension re-attaches with bounded backoff (e.g. 250ms→5s, jittered) until the daemon answers; it never gives up while the session lives.
- G2 Cursor: every consumed frame updates an in-memory cursor per machine alias; re-attach passes since={<alias>:cursor} so frames emitted during the gap are REPLAYED, injected, and acked exactly as #342 does live frames. If the daemon refuses the cursor (beyond spine / unknown machine), fall back to a live-only attach and emit a visible extension notice.
- G3 Key refresh: before each re-attach and on any 401/403 from any client call, re-read <state-dir>/daemon.key so a per-boot key rotation is transparent; pij_send tool works after a restart with no user action.
- G4 Seat continuity: after reconnect confirm the seat is still registered (whoami/seat lookup); if the daemon reports it unknown, re-register with the same id and pane rather than minting a new id.
- G5 Visibility: one short notice line in the omp session on stream loss and on re-attach (`pij: daemon stream lost, reconnecting…` / `pij: re-attached at cursor N`), never silence.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- No change to the daemon delivery/pointer policy (owned by s122/s123).
- No cursor persistence to disk across omp restarts (a fresh omp attaches live-only by design).
- No Claude-harness socket work (s121).
